geometry.taper_lands_scope: Capsule width is normal to its sloping centerline. Bounds above are for the three straight sections; actual complete taper groove cuts are covered by solid-body STL and protected-cavity checks, not a claimed universal numerical wall-thickness minimum.
geometry.load_path: Locator bore -> 4 mm-thick half ear -> volumetric root -> central outer shell; original M3 clamps supply closing force. Pin shear, root bending, print anisotropy and required clamp force remain untested.

locator_nominal_free_play.model: Relative planar rigid pose of halves; ideal smooth holes/pins only.
locator_nominal_free_play.scope: A conservative upper bound, not a attained counterexample or an extra allowance beyond the existing gate budget. No X-gap, tilt, pin deformation, print position, shrinkage, flatness or clamping deformation included.

closure_path_proof: Negative half is restricted to X<=0; translated positive half lies at X>=a for all a>=0. Therefore pure +X-to-zero closing cannot create solid half/half overlap. Pins are checked separately using exact convex continuous sweeps. Adhesive film is not represented by this proof.
open: Official evidence for exact PETG substrate and film joint is absent.
Seal membrane continuation at steps and actual hose/Y interfaces is unresolved.
As-printed dimensional fit, flatness, clamping distortion, load strength and leak rate are untested.
The gate locator bound must enter the complete mechanism tolerance chain; it is not added permission beyond 1 mm.
Nominal checks do not establish printing, slicing, assembly or physical one-ball function.
